source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: When you improve a skill with artificial intelligence assistance, what does human expertise contribute?

options.text: A guarantee that the first draft will work reliably
options.feedback: Expert guidance improves the requirements, but the procedure still needs testing on actual tasks.

options.text: Proof that the agent executed every requested step
options.feedback: A person can specify the steps, but you need evidence of execution to establish that they happened.

options.text: Requirements about important errors and quality
options.feedback: Your experience identifies misunderstandings, costly mistakes, and standards that the agent may fail to infer.

options.text: Automatic installation in every compatible environment
options.feedback: Human expertise shapes the procedure; installation and environment compatibility require separate checks.
